title: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Darkest province of Innistrad, ruled by vampire bloodlines.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane whose provinces and vampires are described.

entities.name: Geier Reach
entities.description: Z-shaped mountain range dominating Stensia, with few passes.

entities.name: Farbogs
entities.description: Twin bogs in the center of Stensia where geists proliferate.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: Huge glowing chasm in the Geier, an infernal gateway from which devils and the demon Shilgengar emerged.

entities.name: Somberwald
entities.description: Pine wilderness of the Geier that shelters noble creatures fled from Kessig.

entities.name: Rinelda Smit
entities.description: Young self-taught ghoulcaller creating ghouls to defend Stensia against vampires.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: Demon that emerged from Ashmouth.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Innistrad's only nonhuman civilization and the biggest threat to humans, bearing a magical 'condition of the blood'.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Eccentric progenitor of the Voldaren bloodline who invented the Court of the Vampire King/Queen.

entities.name: Court of the Vampire King/Queen
entities.description: Three-day vampire holiday in which a kidnapped human is mock-crowned and then killed.

entities.name: Castle Falkenrath
entities.description: Gothic castle in the Geier Reach housing scores of Falkenrath vampires.

entities.name: Voldaren Estate
entities.description: Olivia Voldaren's huge estate near Ziel Pass.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Edgar Markov's manor overlooking Kruin Pass.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Progenitor of the Markov bloodline, the most prestigious, who lives in comparative simplicity.

entities.name: Cosper Lowe
entities.description: Charismatic young captain of the Silbern Guard, apparently the target of a vampire's infatuation.

entities.name: Silbern Guard
entities.description: Cathars based at Silbern Tower who have grown fatalistic since Avacyn vanished.

entities.name: Kastinne
entities.description: Insane woman from Shadowgrange who vowed to slaughter demons after one killed her three children.

entities.name: Traft
entities.description: Living saint who fought demons alongside Avacyn's host; his ghost lingers waiting for the demons' return.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
aliases: Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors
entities.description: Feared and revered inquisitor in his late 30s who wanders Innistrad.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel who is (or was) the living covenant of the balance between humans and vampires; she has disappeared.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: High City visible from Markov Manor, which gives orders to inquisitors.

entities.name: Falkenrath
entities.description: Vampire bloodline concentrated in Stensia, bold in hunting among humans, with a falconer progenitor.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire bloodline whose members live in remote borderlands and master animal transformations.

entities.name: Markov
entities.description: Most prestigious vampire bloodline, present in all four provinces, with psychic talent.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: Vampire bloodline concentrated in Nephalia with powerful glamers.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Progenitor of the Stromkirk line, a high priest in life who worshipped a pre-Avacynian sea and storm god.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: Innistrad province where the Stromkirk concentrate their power.

events.summary: Vampires follow the ritual of siring: a vampire introduces its blood to a victim, who must drink the sire's blood before the next new moon or die.
events.quote: A newly anointed victim who doesn't drink the sire's blood before the next new moon will die.

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren invents the Court of the Vampire King/Queen holiday.
events.quote: This disturbing three-day holiday was invented by Olivia Voldaren .

events.summary: Cosper Lowe begins to realize the disappearances of young women who liked him mean a vampire is infatuated with him.
events.quote: It has just started to dawn on Cosper that this means he's the target of a vampire's infatuation.

events.summary: Avacyn disappears, weakening the holy symbols' power over vampires.
events.quote: although their ability to do so has significantly diminished in the last year (because of Avacyn's disappearance).

events.summary: Kastinne's three children are killed by a demon, and she vows vengeance on all demons.
events.quote: A demon killed her three children, and she has vowed to slaughter it and every other demon until her children's souls find rest.

relations.quote: The progenitor of the Voldaren line, Olivia Voldaren
This is the bloodline of Edgar Markov and is the most prestigious of the bloodlines.
Stromkirk's progenitor, Runo Stromkirk, was a high priest in life
their captain, a classically handsome young man named Cosper, continues to command admiration.

relations.note: Lies in the middle strip of the range
relations.quote: In the middle strip of the Geier Reach, between the Hofsaddel and Getander Passes, lies Castle Falkenrath
